content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-minimum-viable-stack-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-20|Building a]]-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-works-how-17|building]] on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe provide users with a streamlined process for selling courses, offering integrated payment processing and delivery. However, these platforms dictate terms based on geography, rendering them useless for creators in many regions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, offers complete ownership of your digital store, ensuring autonomy over sales processes and data, free from external restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like PayPal and Gumroad frequently exclude users in countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, citing regulatory compliance as the reason. This exclusion often leads to frustration for creators who cannot access their funds. Additionally, a PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, provides a permanent solution by enabling creators to process payments through cryptocurrencies, ensuring access regardless of geographic constraints.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While Stripe and PayPal promise quick payments, the reality can be different for those in restricted countries. Delays, holds, and fees can significantly impact cash flow. In contrast, using a system like NOWPayments with the Edge Commerce Stack ensures low transaction fees (only 0.5%) and rapid payment confirmation through on-chain processing. This model eliminates the uncertainty associated with traditional payment processors, allowing for immediate access to funds.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures complete ownership of your digital assets.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Teachable and similar platforms maintain control over your sales infrastructure, which can be problematic if services are interrupted. In contrast, adopting sovereign commerce infrastructure means creators retain full ownership of their digital assets. With automated payment processing and file delivery managed through platforms like Cloudflare and Supabase, creators can effectively manage their stores independently, ensuring a seamless experience for their customers without reliance on any single entity.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between traditional platforms and sovereign commerce infrastructure hinges on your geographic location and business needs. For those in restricted regions, opting for an Edge Commerce Stack is the clear path forward. It offers a fully operational store deployed in 48 hours, integrating tools that safeguard your operations from the disruptions faced with conventional platforms. Evaluate your needs to determine whether the autonomy of sovereign architecture aligns with your goals.

This architecture allows you to set up a fully operational online store with integrated crypto payment processing, ensuring you retain ownership over your data and sales. It’s a reliable alternative to platforms that discriminate based on location.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
